let reads = 0;
class Changed {}
Object.defineProperty(Changed, 'name', {
  get() { reads++; return 'Name' + reads; },
});
const item = new Changed();
console.log(item);
console.log(reads);
console.dir(item, { showHidden: true });
console.log(reads);
const p = Object.create(Changed.prototype, {
  hidden: { get() { reads++; return reads; }, configurable: true },
});
console.dir(Object.create(p), { showHidden: true, getters: true });
console.log(reads);
class NamedError extends Error {}
Object.defineProperty(NamedError, 'name', { get() { throw new Error('name read'); } });
try { console.log(Object.create(NamedError.prototype)); }
catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error) console.log(error.message); }
